tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Text on it: `fg`, `muted`; `accent`, `warm` and `danger` pass AA here, `ok` does not in light (4.44), so `ok` text on `bg` becomes `fg` with an `ok` icon.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, the chat window, buttons' ground. Every text token passes AA on it in every theme. Text on an `ok` fill is `surface`.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, the agent's bubbles, tracks, hover. Text on it is `fg` or `muted`: `accent`, `ok` and `danger` miss AA here in light (4.38, 4.06, 4.38), so they move to an underline or an icon.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Text, on `bg`, `surface` and `sunken` (12.48 to 15.33 in every theme), and on any tint.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, meta, idle icons, on `bg`, `surface` and `sunken` (4.81 to 6.89; 7.25 to 9.45 in the more-contrast themes). Also the boundary of every control (inputs, checkboxes, the hold button, secondary buttons): `line` is too faint for that.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative borders and dividers only (1.49 on `surface`). A control's boundary uses `muted`. In the more-contrast themes it reaches 3:1 on every ground, so every boundary does.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Kelp: primary actions, the owner's bubbles, focus rings, links, progress. As text, on `bg` and `surface` (4.80 / 5.38 light); never as text on `sunken` in light (4.38).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill (5.31 light, 7.83 dark), and the mascot's `?` and `!` on its `warm` and `danger` bubbles.

tokens.name: warm
tokens.usage: Attention: the owner needs to act (an agent is waiting, a free tier passed 90%). Nothing else uses it. As text on `bg`, `surface` and `sunken` (4.56 to 9.56 in every theme). Text on a `warm` fill is `on-accent`.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Done, approved, turned on. A filled `ok` button carries `surface` text (4.98 light, 7.86 dark). As text only on `surface` in light (4.98).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and refusals that need action. As text on `bg` and `surface`; on `sunken` in light it is an icon, not text (4.38). Text on a `danger` fill is `on-accent`.

easing.note: The seven springs as CSS linear() easings (21 points each, simulated with semi-implicit Euler in 1 ms steps), and the four curves.

tokens.name: spring-fast
tokens.usage: Spring 1400 / 0.9. Chips, labels that roll, the palette, highlights. Runs over `spring-fast-dur`.

tokens.name: spring-base
tokens.usage: Spring 700 / 0.9. Bubbles, cards, lists, panels. Runs over `spring-base-dur`.

tokens.name: spring-slow
tokens.usage: Spring 300 / 0.9. Large surfaces, drawers, a mascot dozing off. Runs over `spring-slow-dur`.

tokens.name: spring-moment-fast
tokens.usage: Spring 800 / 0.6. A released hold, small moment feedback. Runs over `spring-moment-fast-dur`.

tokens.name: spring-moment
tokens.usage: Spring 380 / 0.8. Moment layout: a button that grows, a card that collapses, a mascot's pose. Runs over `spring-moment-dur`.

tokens.name: spring-moment-slow
tokens.usage: Spring 200 / 0.8. Travel: subagents leaving their parent, links drawing. Runs over `spring-moment-slow-dur`.

tokens.name: spring-pop
tokens.usage: Spring 800 / 0.55, Kelpie's own. Confirmations: a check, a vault that receives, a mascot that changes state, and its bubble. Runs over `spring-pop-dur`.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Movement that is not a spring.

tokens.name: ease-fade
tokens.usage: Opacity and color. Colors never overshoot (rule 3).

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Every exit, with `dur-exit` or `dur-exit-moment`.

tokens.name: ease-travel
tokens.usage: Travel across the screen to where something is kept (a note into the vault), over `dur-travel`.
